Zachary D. Carter is the author of The Price of Peace: Money, Democracy and the Life of John Maynard Keynes. Selected by The New York Times, The Economist, Publishers Weekly, Bloomberg, Mother Jones, TechCrunch and others as one of the best books of 2020, The Price of Peace has been longlisted for the Cundill History Prize and shortlisted for the SABEW Best in Business Award.
